The overall appearance is of necrosis and desiccation, starting from the leaf tissue and potentially progressing from the tip or edges, although the point of attachment to the stem is not fully visible. This aligns well with the description of "Die_Back," which includes leaves turning brown with a scorch-like appearance before dropping and twigs dying back. The other descriptions do not fit. "Sooty_Mould" involves dark fungal deposits on a green leaf. "Anthracnose" involves distinct black spots that expand. "Powdery_Mildew" is not described but typically looks like a white powder. The widespread browning and death of the leaf are most consistent with Die_Back.
